 Around the NFL Patriots QB Drake Maye (ankle) questionable to return vs. Lions
 Published: Loading... Around the NFL Staff NFL.com Share Facebook Share Twitter New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye suffered an ankle injury against the Detroit Lions and is questionable to return.
 Maye appeared to suffer the injury on a first-quarter sack by Lions pass rusher Aidan Hutchinson , who was also injured on the play.
 Maye walked off the field under his own power and went to the bench. He then went to the locker room with trainers.
 The third-year QB was 3-of-4 passing for 48 yards, with an 11-yard scramble, at the time of his exit.
 Tommy DeVito is in at quarterback.
 Around the NFL will have more on this story shortly.
